yt_title: The next good small business gets people off their phones
caption:
The next good small business gets people off their phones.

A saved reel said businesses that get people present will be worth a lot. Ideas that cost little to start:
1. A phone-free run or walk club
2. Trivia or board game nights at a cafe
3. Hands-on workshops: pottery, cooking, woodwork

Start with one event and charge per ticket.

Sorted by SaveSort. Sort your saves free, link in bio.
